# St Thomas Heating & Cooling

> Heating and cooling requests for St. Thomas. Thermostat service concerns diagnosing control faults or replacing a thermostat with a model compatible with the connected HVAC equipment.

Email: contact@stthomasheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://stthomasheatingcooling.ca

Request locations: St. Thomas, London, Strathroy, Dorchester, Komoka, Aylmer, Lucan. Coverage and availability require provider confirmation.
